title: Reply Triage Router - webhook payload
description: Generic payload accepted by the Reply Webhook. The workflow also accepts tolerant aliases (see src/normalize.js), but sending this shape is the most reliable. Never send credentials in the payload.

replyId.description: Provider message/reply ID. Used for de-duplication. If omitted, a stable hash is generated.

receivedAt.description: When the reply arrived. Used to resolve dates like 'back on Monday'. Defaults to now.

body.description: Plain-text reply. Either body or html is required.

html.description: HTML reply, used only if body is empty.

headers.description: Optional raw email headers. Auto-Submitted / X-Autoreply / X-Autorespond / Precedence: auto_reply mark an out-of-office reply.

email.description: Your contact's email if different from the sender.
